issues.description: In Bar 12, the kinetic punchline banner text 'O(K / N) EFFICIENCY: ZERO CLUSTER THRASH!' slightly clips the last two characters ('NG') into 'THRASH!' or hits the right padding edge of the banner container.
issues.concrete_fix: Reduce the banner font-size slightly from 24px to 21px or shorten the string to 'O(K/N) EFFICIENCY: ZERO THRASH!' in the bar 12 punchline configuration.
